text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, I spot an exhausted-looking Grass Wonder on her way to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ngh, so dizzy… The sky is there, that's the ground, and that's… Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer, do you appreciate how wonderful it is… to have your feet on solid ground?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Have you ever seen the red sports car that is often parked in the academy's lot?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzen offered to take me for a spin in it, and I regret to say I didn't know better.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Have you ever wondered what it would be like if cars could fly? It's an unforgettable experience… Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She giggles to herself while staring off into space. Note to self: steer clear of the sports car.
